column3: Stepped Brass Washer / Thrust Disc / Shaft Disc
column4: NEWLY DOCUMENTED PART (not in original dataset). Single stepped brass/bronze disc on the LOWER journal SHF-003 (fan/basket end), riding OUTSIDE the lower housing face — believed to set axial position / end-float (thrust washer). Distinct from ARM-008 and ARM-009, and from the seated bearing (BRG-002/BRG-011 remain in the housing). Stepped profile (confirmed by edge-on photo, NOT two stacked parts). Journal location CONFIRMED (SHF-003, fan end). DIMS: outer step OD 0.8125" = 13/16" (CONFIRMED, housing side); inner step OD 0.7825" ~25/32" (CONFIRMED, basket side); bore ID 0.2800" = 9/32" (CONFIRMED, slip-fits lower journal SHF-003 Ø0.280"). overall thickness 0.1075" (CONFIRMED 2026-06-15). FUNCTION: liquid/oil SLINGER (REF — WatchRepairTalk forum consensus: the grooved disk just below the motor housing on the shaft is a 'slinger' that keeps jar fluid from wicking up the shaft into the motor; matches our as-found on SHF-003). May also act as a thrust/locating feature. INSTALLED RUNNING GAP (R-9, 2026-06-21): on reassembly leave a small gap between the slinger and the lower-housing face - do NOT bottom it out; target ~0.0255" (a utility-knife-blade width), taken from the restorer's second L&R unit (the as-found gap was not measured before removal). Press slow/incremental and gauge with a blade/feeler. Bench-confirm optional

NEWLY DOCUMENTED PART (found 2026-06-19). Flat washer on the LOWER journal SHF-003, INSIDE the housing, stacked on TOP of the lower bearing (BRG-002) at the very bottom of the armature. QTY 3 (matched by OD/bore; colors vary tan/deep-red/amber, typical of the stock). PHENOLIC washer (thermoset resin — reddish-brown/amber, the classic phenolic insulating washer), NON-CONDUCTIVE, oil/heat-resistant. (Non-metal CONFIRMED 2026-06-19; material identified as phenolic 2026-06-20.) Armature-specific shim, not a generic hardware washer. DIMS: OD 0.630" (CONFIRMED); bore ID 0.2850" (CONFIRMED, slip-fits lower journal SHF-003 Ø0.280"); thickness 0.0170" each (CONFIRMED). FUNCTION: thrust/spacer shim stack — sets rotor axial height (end-float) so the cooling fan (ARM-007) clears the lower housing floor and spins freely; red fiber also electrically isolates rotor from bearing. Stacked with ARM-012; combined stack thickness 0.0650" (CONFIRMED). Internal — distinct from external slinger ARM-010.

column3: Pole Core / Salient Pole Core / Field Frame / Back Iron
column4: Single one-piece laminated electrical steel salient-pole core; has two DISTINCT pole sections (left + right) but is NOT split into separable halves. Continuous top and bottom yoke arcs join the two inward-projecting salient poles with aggressively waisted sides; each pole terminates in an integral pole shoe (STR-006/007), with the field coil seated in the neck between yoke and shoe. The two "half-moon" pole regions each measure outer arc 4.000" (CONFIRMED); yoke radial thickness 0.200" (CONFIRMED); stack height 0.736" (CONFIRMED); chord hole-to-hole 2.300" (CONFIRMED). 4 mounting holes total: 2 pass-through for housing tie-bolts (FLG-002), 2 for dedicated stator mount screws (STR-008). Seats against housing inner bore (outer radius 1.500")
